## Closable interface

A resource that holds something open — a socket, a file handle, a pool.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface Closable 
```

## Remarks

[Manager.close()](./support.manager.close.md) probes each resolved driver for this shape, so a driver that owns no resources simply omits `close` rather than implementing an empty one.
